description: 礦災災害防救業務計畫 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 為有效防止礦場災害，維護礦場安全，依據災害防救法第十九條第二項及礦場安全法暨施行細則之規定，並參照「災害防害防救法第十九條第二項及礦場安全法暨施行細則之規定，並參照「災害防救基本計畫」訂定「礦災災害防救業務計畫」。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 開創事業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-06-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
